'''Lopor Station''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Quantana]] started out his career as a child in the streets of the planet.<ref name="BM">{{WEGCite|story=Buyer's Market (Galaxy Guide 10)|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
